title: Critique: consciousness requires carbon biology or electrochemical processing

statements.text: On one view consciousness requires carbon-based biology, which language models lack. On a related view, held by Ned Block, it requires a sort of electrochemical processing that silicon systems lack. Either would rule out all silicon-based AI consciousness, and a survey suggests a collective credence of at least one in three that biology is required.

sources.quote: consciousness requires a certain sort of electrochemical processing that silicon systems lack
might tend to suggest a collective credence of at least one in three that biology is required for consciousness
